_comment: EMISSION_AUTH_MSG_V1 — pinned known-answer vectors for the reward-emission vin consensus surfaces: the two role auth digests (emission_wire::auth_msg — the R1.A emission_auth_msg inventory under the Q1 role-distinct cSHAKE256 customizations) and the serialized 0x04 vin wire bytes.
